Welcome to Ideogram
Ideogram ( pronounced "eye-dee-oh-gram" ) is a free-to-use AI tool that turns your ideas into stunning images, in a matter of seconds. Ideogram excels at creating captivating designs, realistic images, innovative logos and posters. With unique capabilities like text rendering in images, we aim to inspire creativity and help every user bring their imagination to life.
Ideogram 4.0 is the newest generation model for prompt fidelity, clearer in-image text, reliable editing, style control, and production-ready visual assets.
Have a question? Check if it's been covered in our Frequently Asked Questions .
Why Ideogram?
Ideogram 4.0
Prompt fidelity, crystal-clear type, reliable editing, and production-ready image workflows across the app, API, MCP, and open weights.
Background Control
Remove a background for a transparent cutout, or replace it with a generated scene from a prompt.
Typography
Ideogram excels at integrating text into images for logos, branding, POD, or design layouts.
Custom Models
Train on-brand image models from your approved assets so generations follow your style, art direction, typography, and visual identity.
A few other features
Prompt Builder : Compose a scene element by element — or import an image — and turn it into a precise, structured prompt.
AI Apps: Task-focused workflows for specific jobs, such as the Background Remover , Object Remover, and Ad Resizer.
Magic Prompt : Transforms a brief idea into a rich, detailed prompt, ensuring striking visuals.
Custom Models : Train models on approved brand, subject, or style assets where your plan and account support them.
Background Control : Remove or replace backgrounds to isolate subjects or craft new scenes.
Aspect Ratios : Choose from many presets (vertical, square, horizontal) between 1:3 and 3:1.
And much more to discover!
Ways to use Ideogram
App : Hands-on image creation and editing.
API : Product and workflow integration.
MCP : MCP lets assistants and internal agents use Ideogram inside their workflows, including generating, editing, reframing, upscaling, removing backgrounds, and organizing visual assets.
